agents.name: drive-unblock-01
agents.question: Can a locally built .docx reach Google Drive without an s3key?
agents.result: yes via the platform upload tool (mints s3key for a file already in a saved location); a local path is refused before any Drive call. Loop proven end to end: bank-statement-5-pages 42/47 reproduced.
